latest_features: Injector now downloads C7-WorldProxy.exe into AppData automatically, so bedrocktool no longer needs to sit next to the injector
Proxy helper downloads are cached under the Minecraft AppData C7-Client folder and refreshed against the current release version when needed
Private and public release pipelines now publish C7-WorldProxy.exe alongside the injector, DLL, version.json, and world proxy target template
The proxy helper asset is pinned to the upstream bedrock-tool/bedrocktool Windows build so releases stay reproducible
